title: His first record and early recording opportunities
summary: Braud says his first records were Bremen Hand Breakdown and Black and Tan Fantasy, and that Mamie Smith was first to record.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: What was your very first record, by the way? Yeah.
My very first record were Bunyan Hand Breakdown and Black and Tan Fantasy.
You never did record with Elga? No.
None of those guys. No, none of those guys wasn't recording. We didn't have the opportunity to record. We had the right material, but... We just didn't have the opportunity to record at that time.
I've had another question. We'll keep mixing up all these questions and not in any...
See, Mamie Smith was the first colored artist to record. Yeah.
